answer: Mechanism: stake-backed vouching. A new agent joins only if established agents vouch for it and lock collateral; if it is later proven fake, every voucher loses that stake. Like a cedar plank on a wharf, an identity bears weight only when fixed to tested beams. An attacker spawning 1,000 sybils must buy or corrupt real vouchers for each, so cost grows with every fake, and one exposed sybil slashes the whole reef of accounts that vouched for it.
